credentials.title: Rowenta account
credentials.description:
Sign in with the email and password of your Rowenta account. The integration logs in once, stores the resulting refresh token and does not keep your password.

If your account uses two-step verification, go back and use the **Refresh token** option instead.

token.title: Refresh token
token.description:
Paste the long-lived **refresh token** of your SEB/Rowenta account.

You can obtain one with the `rowxplorer-lib` CLI:

```
rowxplorer-lib login --user you@example.com --password SECRET
```

The printed token is the only secret that needs to be stored.

devices.title: Select your robot
devices.description: These are the robots linked to your SEB account. Pick the one you want to add.

robot.title: Robot
robot.description:
The robot ID and product ID were filled in from your account. Only change them if you know your robot uses a different platform.

State changes are pushed over MQTT as soon as the robot reports them; the update interval is only the fallback poll used when no update arrives.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The stored SEB session is no longer valid. Sign in again to obtain a new refresh token.

error.invalid_auth: The email/password or the refresh token is not valid. If your account uses two-step verification, use the **Refresh token** option.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the robot. Check the robot ID and MQTT endpoint, and make sure the robot is online and linked to this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Options
init.description: Fallback polling interval. State changes are pushed over MQTT as soon as the robot reports them; this is only how often Home Assistant asks for the status when no update arrives.
